name: Centurion Corporation Limited
summary: Centurion Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, owns, manages, and operates purpose-built accommodation assets in Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Worker Accommodation, Student Accommodation, and Others. It offers dormitory accommodation and services for workers and professionals under the Westlite Accommodation brand name; and for students under the Dwell and EPIISOD brand names. The company also manufactures and sells optical storage media and other trading goods.
